correctness.rationale: Under lax team semantics, disjunction of n distinct constancy atoms means all relation tuples can be covered by n axis-parallel coordinate hyperplanes, one fixed value per coordinate. For infinite teams, a finite-character induction fixes a root tuple and one coordinate satisfying every finite subteam, reducing to n-1 coordinates. For finite inclusion-minimal un-coverable U, deletion of each u has a coordinate hyperplane cross-cover missing u; labeling finite values in Q gives tensor factors P(v)=tensor(1,h_i(v_i)) and Q(u)=tensor(-h_i(a_i^(u)),1), producing a diagonal pairing with all diagonal values nonzero. Thus |U|<=dim((Q^2)^tensor n)=2^n. The full Boolean cube is an inclusion-minimal obstruction of that size; any <=n tuples are coverable, and an n+1 point diagonal is minimally failing. Handles n=1, empty and infinite teams; do not confuse at-most-size coherence with exactly-k convention.
